title: 第5章 问心路
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
至于被她整得惨兮兮的男主，谁在乎呢？

    自己从一开始表现的就是骄纵不可一世的大小姐形象，他还傻傻往雷点上撞，能怪得了谁？

    太虚宗山脚下，经典入门问心路。

    按照她以前遍览群书的经验，此时太虚宗大佬们肯定汇聚一堂，围着水镜盯着她们这批新入门弟子的一切动作。

    在这个过程中，男主必定会展露头角，然后被一群大佬抢着要。

    不过现在自己和统子来了，谁都别想比她还装。

    “统子，你说我们要怎么才能在问心路上亮瞎他们的眼？”微生璃月暗搓搓道。

    她现在感觉，走统子那种夸张风格也不错，非常的吸引人注意，主要是装逼值来的多。

    “亲爱的宿主大人，系统这边建议你兑换步生莲特效加强版（可无伤通过问心路），限时骨折价只需要100装逼值哦！”

    “无伤通过？那就兑换。”听到能无伤通过问心路，微生璃月立马心动。

    她现在可是拥有3983装逼值的小富婆，100装逼值又算得了什么。

    此时太虚宗议事大厅，各峰峰主正围着水镜查看山脚下的情况。

    面对突然出现且行事嚣张的微生璃月，几人神色复杂。

    刚刚掌门去救下那个叶不凡的场景他们都看得到，连掌门都不是那少女身边仆从的对手，那他们就更不是了，也不知道大小姐来他们这个小破落宗门干什么。

    清清声，慕鹤云稍有些不自然地开口：“诸位，要是她真的上来了，你们当中可否有人愿收她为徒？”

    这个“她”是谁，众人自然清楚。

    回应慕鹤云的是一片沉默，本来他们太虚宗这些年就逐渐落寞，实力大不如从前，各峰资源都紧张。

    要是再请这么一尊阴晴不定的大神到自己峰上，明显是给自己找罪受。

    “掌门，你是太虚宗掌事，最擅长教化弟子，你看要不就让她进你门下如何！”丹峰长老莫青瓷试探道。

    掌门来这一出，明显是自己也不想要这个弟子，偏偏又拒绝不了她入门，才会把压力甩出来。

    可自己不想要就丢给他们，这不行，他们也伺候不来这尊大神。
content_en:
As for the male protagonist who was made miserable by her, who cares?

From the very beginning, she had shown the image of a domineering young lady, and yet he foolishly bumped into something wrong. Who can blame her?

At the foot of Taixu Sect Mountain, you can learn about the classics.

According to her previous experience of reading many books, the Taixu Sect bosses must have gathered together at this time, staring at all the movements of their new disciples around the water mirror.

In this process, the male protagonist will definitely show his prominence, and then he will be competed by a group of big guys.

But now that she and Tongzi are here, no one can pretend to be better than her.

"Tongzi, what do you think we can do to blind them on the road to questioning their minds?" Weisheng Liyue said secretly.

She now feels that Zuo Tongzi's exaggerated style is not bad, it is very attractive, mainly because it is worth more to show off.

"Dear Master Host, the system recommends that you exchange for the enhanced version of Bu Sheng Lian with special effects (you can pass the Inquiry Without Injury). The limited-time fracture price only costs 100 pretentiousness points!"

"Passed without injury? Then exchange it." Upon hearing that he could pass without injury, Weisheng Liyue was immediately moved.

She is now a rich little woman with 3983 pretentiousness points, so 100 pretentiousness points is nothing.

At this time, in the Taixu Sect's meeting hall, the peak masters were surrounding the water mirror to check the situation at the foot of the mountain.

Facing the sudden appearance and arrogant behavior of Wei Sheng Liyue, several people had complicated expressions.

They could all see the scene where the leader had just rescued Ye Bufan. Even the leader was no match for the servants around the girl, so they were even less so. They didn't know what the eldest lady was doing in this small run-down sect of theirs.

In a clear voice, Mu Heyun spoke a little unnaturally: "Everyone, if she really comes up, would any of you be willing to accept her as your disciple?"

Everyone knows who this "she" is.

There was silence in response to Mu Heyun. Originally, their Taixu Sect had gradually become lonely over the years, their strength was not as good as before, and the resources of each peak were tight.

If you invite such a volatile great god to your peak again, you are obviously looking for trouble for yourself.

"Master, you are the master of Taixu Sect and you are the best at teaching disciples. How about letting her join your sect!" Danfeng elder Mo Qingci tried her best.

When the leader came, it was obvious that he didn't want this disciple, but he couldn't refuse her entry, so he was throwing away the pressure.

But if you don't want it, just leave it to them. This won't work, and they won't be able to serve this great god.
